loops.name: Turn loop
loops.description: One user message and everything the assistant does until the closing message.

phases.name: plan
phases.description: create/update tasks in the task tree

phases.name: respond
phases.description: single closing message; earlier text folds into an activity log

loops.name: Delegation loop
loops.description: Decompose, dispatch workers, sleep, wake on notices, review, steer or close, synthesize.

phases.name: dispatch
phases.description: tasks create + tasks start; worker runs its own Turn loop in its own thread

loops.name: Skill loop
loops.description: Match a domain skill, load it, follow it every turn, unload.

loops.name: Memory loop
loops.description: After each turn facts and summaries are extracted, stored, and injected into the next turn.

phases.name: extract
phases.description: after each turn: facts + summaries auto-extracted

phases.name: inject
phases.description: Active Memory in next turn's context

loops.name: Human-in-the-loop
loops.description: Gated actions wait for a human decision before the agent continues.

phases.name: notify
phases.description: user is notified of the pending decision

phases.name: wake
phases.description: agent is woken with the decision
